name: Colorado Waffle Jostle 2023

venue.name: Embassy Suites
venue.details: Right near the intersection of I70 and I 225. Parking is available by the hotel.  No outside food allowed.

information: You MUST read the required tabs on the website before registering for the competition. These tabs pertain to COVID-19 safety, and your responsibilities as a competitior. The competitor limit for this competition is only 90 competitors, so be sure to register quick to get a spot! Please note that each competitor is only allowed to bring two guests. There is limited space in the venue, and we want to ensure that as many people as possible have the opportunity to compete. Thank you for your compliance. NOTE: THERE IS NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK ALLOWED INSIDE THE VENUE.
